extra_facts.fact: Kane off in the 20th minute for Tom Bischof with a ligament tear in his left ankle; Bayern said he will be out 'for the next few months'; Eberl expects about three months.
Kane and Olise account for 22 of Bayern's 54 goals (41%) this season.
Olise substituted at half-time (Binder on 45'), bruised forefoot.
14 of Bayern's 17 shots were worth under 0.10 xG; their best single chance was 0.28.
Yellow cards: Upamecano 62', S. El Mala 66' (commentary covers 62' onwards only).

standing.fact: Bayern 1st on 22 points from 10 games, Dortmund 2nd on 21 from 9 (Dortmund visit Gladbach on Saturday); Cologne 14th on 10 from 10.
